[[File:Snowball.png|180px|thumb|A snowball]]
'''Snowballs''' were spherical objects made of [[Water/Legends|snow]] that were often thrown at friends and enemies as a harmless type of weapon. Snowballs were subject to melting, especially on [[Temperature/Legends|warmer]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Many snowballs were created with the help of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] [[Hoth Snow Machine|snow machines]], a type of snow-maker popular during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Wampa/Legends|Wampas]] could throw giant snowballs at vehicles.
